items.src: هذه الجملة اللي كنا دائماً نسمعها بشكل كبير: البعض يعتقد إنه أنا اليوم عشان أتعلم لازم يكون عندي كتاب وأقعد أقرأ، ولا إني أقعد مع على قولة كوتش.
items.ref: This is the phrase we have always heard so much: some people believe that in order to learn today, I must have a book and sit down to read, or sit with, as they say, a coach.
items.hypothesis: This is the sentence we always heard a lot: some people think that today to learn I need to have a book and sit and read, or that I need to sit with... by the way, that's a quote.

items.src: هل الصحيح في كلمة تعلّم إني أنا أجي أقول والله باخذ كتاب وأقرأ، ولا أروح لمدرب، ولا أجلس في فصل ومجموعة تعليم؟ ولا المفروض إنه الحياة مدرسة وأيضاً التجربة مدرسة؟
items.ref: Does learning truly mean just picking up a book to read, going to a trainer, or sitting in a classroom and study group? Or is life itself supposed to be a school, and experience a school as well?
items.hypothesis: Is it true that the word 'I'll go learn' means I'll take a book and read, or go to a trainer, or sit in a classroom with a group? Or isn't it supposed to be that life is a school and also the experience is a school?

items.src: سمعنا يمكن كثير من الحوارات اللي صارت ما بين إن الأكاديميين ما يعرفون ينفذون، واللي ينفذون ما عندهم أساس علمي، كيف نفصل ما بين هؤلاء الاثنين؟ وهل نقدر نقول عن الاثنين تعليم؟
items.ref: We have probably heard many debates claiming that academics do not know how to execute, and practitioners lack a scientific foundation; how do we distinguish between these two, and can we call both of them learning?
items.hypothesis: We've probably heard many of the conversations that happened between academics who don't know how to implement, and those who implement without a scientific basis. How do we differentiate between these two? And can we say both are education?

items.src: نعم، التعلم فيه تقريباً ثلاث مصادر: المصادر الصلبة مثل الكتب والدورات والمسموعات والمقروءات، أنت وطريقتك في التعلم.
items.ref: Yes, learning has roughly three sources: solid sources such as books, courses, audio materials, and readings, depending on your own way of learning.
items.hypothesis: Yes, learning has about three sources: the solid sources like books and courses and podcasts and readings, and your way of learning.

items.src: في ناس ما يقدر يقرأ كتاب، في ناس يحب يسمع كثير، وفي ناس حتى لو سمع تلقى معه قلم وورقة ويدون ويسجل، وفي ناس يحب يتأمل.
items.ref: Some people cannot read a book, some like to listen a lot, some even when listening have a pen and paper to take notes and record, and others like to reflect.
items.hypothesis: Some people can't read a book, some like to listen a lot, and some, even if they hear, you find with him a pen and paper and he writes and records, and some like to contemplate.

items.src: في ناس يحب يلتقط ما يهمه فقط، تلقاه يقلب الكتاب، يقلب في الدورة، يسرّع، يبغى يسمع ما يهمه فقط.
items.ref: Some people like to pick up only what matters to them; you find them flipping through the book, skipping through the course, speeding it up, wanting to hear only what interests them.
items.hypothesis: There are people who like to pick up only what interests them, you find him flipping through the book, flipping through the chapters, speeding up, wanting to hear only what interests him.

items.src: ففي المصادر الصلبة هذه: المجلات العلمية، الكتب، الرسائل، أياً كان. ثمت مصدر معرفي آخر وهو الأكثر التصاقاً بالواقع، وهي تجارب الآخرين.
items.ref: So alongside these solid sources—scientific journals, books, theses, whatever they may be—there is another source of knowledge that is much closer to reality, which is the experiences of others.
items.hypothesis: So among the solid sources: scientific journals, books, messages, whatever. There's another cognitive source that's the most closely tied to reality, and that's other people's experiences.

items.src: تجارب الآخرين منها المختص. أحياناً أبغى أتعلم أقرأ من كتاب، طيب قرأت كتب كثير وسمعت محاضرات كثير، باقي حاجات ما أستطيع أجدها في الكتب، أذهب للمصدر الثاني اللي هو المختص.
items.ref: Among the experiences of others is the specialist. Sometimes I want to learn by reading a book, so I read many books and listened to many lectures, yet there are still things I cannot find in books; then I go to the second source, which is the specialist.
items.hypothesis: Other people's experiences, some of them, the specialist. Sometimes I want to learn, I read from a book, okay, I've read many books and listened to many lectures, the rest of things I can't find in books, I go to the second source which is the specialist.

items.src: فكرة المختص هو صاحب الشهادة، لأن عندنا مختص، وعندنا خبير، وعندنا مهتم.
items.ref: The concept of a specialist is someone who holds an academic degree, because we have a specialist, we have an expert, and we have an enthusiast.
items.hypothesis: The idea of the specialist is the one with the degree, because we have a specialist, and we have an expert, and we have an interested one.

items.src: المختص صاحب شهادة، الخبير صاحب تجربة، والمهتم صاحب ميدان.
items.ref: The specialist holds a credential, the expert possesses practical experience, and the enthusiast is active in the field.
